posts.name: Aman
posts.cooked:
Sir, @sayan @AtulPS @Subendu

I have opted for OPPE and End term only this term and same says on my course card of SC but unlike other courses it is not showing previous term’s marks and is updated to absent for 1st week’s result. I am still submitting BPTs for OPPE eligibility. Please refer to the attached image and let me know If I have to submit upcoming assignments.

Thank you

image447×515 24.5 KB

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
That is the expected behaviour your previous score are not visible here. You can check previous scores by going to “Completed & pending courses” then click on System Commands. All scores will be automatically added from previous term expect end term & OPPE and will get reflected in your final score. Don’t worry!

Do BPTs for OPPE eligibility (which you are doing).

posts.name: Aman
posts.cooked: Thanks for clarifying
